_context.welcome.preparing: Shimmering line under the welcome title while the first turn of the onboarding starts.
_context.header.newTask: Button that starts a new conversation with the Foreman.
_context.header.position.float: Menu option: the chat floats in a corner of the screen instead of being docked.
_context.modelPill.hubReason: Tooltip on the disabled model picker. Rerun Balanced is the name of a model, keep it as is.
_context.signupGate.perks.trial: {days} is the length of the free trial in days.
_context.signInLink.prompt: <link> wraps the clickable part that opens the sign-in dialog.
_context.dock.tooltip: Tooltip of the Foreman orb. <key> wraps the keyboard shortcut, {shortcut} is that shortcut (e.g. ⌘F).
_context.nudge.more: Count of other questions waiting besides the one shown.
_context.nudge.answer: Button: go and answer the question.
_context.nudge.later: Button: dismiss the card for now.
_context.voice.listening: Space is the keyboard key held down to record.
_context.pill.prompts.lastNight: Example question typed in the placeholder of the ask field.
_context.routines.options: Accessible label of the menu button of a routine. {name} is the routine's name.
_context.intake.settingUp: {title} is the name of the template or coworker the person picked before signing up. <highlight> wraps it.
_context.intake.role.placeholder: Example job title in an empty field.
_context.intake.name.placeholder: Example first name in an empty field.
_context.intake.skip: Button: skip the company website question.
_context.ownEntry: The way out of the onboarding cards: the person already knows which coworker they want and writes it themselves.
_context.gettingStarted.pillLabel: Accessible label of the checklist pill.
_context.gettingStarted.reward.lockedDescription: {total} is the number of steps of the checklist, {remaining} how many are left.
_context.contact.defaultSummary: Message sent to the support team on the person's behalf, written in the first person.
_context.template.buildElse: Button: the person wants something else built instead of the template offered.
_context.plan.goesAfter: Label before what the coworker targets. <label> wraps the label, {need} is the target.
_context.plan.previousBox: A Box is a department of the board (Marketing, Support...). Keep the word Box.
_context.plan.standingBy: The coworker is idle, waiting for its next task.
_context.starterPack.hireMany: Button that confirms the coworkers picked in the starter pack. {count} is 2 or more.
_context.starterPack.pick: Button on a card: add this coworker to the picks.
_context.arrival.youPicked: Small uppercase label above the name of the template the person picked.
_context.arrival.by: {name} is the author of the template.
_context.arrival.gestures.installed: Last step of the progress rail: the template is installed.
_context.trial.dueOn: {date} is the day the trial ends and the first charge happens.
_context.trial.includes: {agents} is a number of coworkers, {credits} a number of credits.
_context.purchase.billedTo: {name} is the name of the workspace.
_context.teamEmptyState.buildPrompt: Prefilled in the composer: the start of the user's own sentence to the assistant, completed by them. Keep the trailing space.
_context.plan.lifeDelivered: Caption under a coworker block in an animated preview of its day: it finished and handed the result to the user.
_context.gettingStarted.prompts: Messages sent to the assistant in the user's name when they click a step of the getting started checklist. First person, the user speaking.
